title: 第7章 再啰嗦连你一起打
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: “辰楠，你怎么能这样！”柳如意终于反应过来，上前一步质问道，“快放开常伟！”“别以为你是女人就安全。”辰楠转头瞥了她一眼，目光冷冽如刀，“你再啰嗦一句，连你一起打。”柳如意被那眼神吓得后退半步，嘴唇哆嗦着，却再也不敢出声。她从未见过这样的辰楠——从前的辰楠对她百依百顺，连句重话都不曾说过，如今却像是换了个人。围观的邻居们瞪大双眼，纷纷发出一阵惊呼。现在所发生的一幕实在是太陌生。在他们眼里的辰楠虽然有一米八高大个子，剑眉星目，五官端正帅气，（就如在场的读者大大们）但是，辰楠身体太过羸弱，缺乏营养，一副发育不良的模样，典型的文弱书生，人老实话不多。辰楠今日这番变化，实属超出他们的想象。“好家伙，这辰楠是彻底豁出去了啊！以前对那姑娘那么好，可现在都敢怼她了。”“看来真是被逼急了，不过也是，那俩人也太不是东西了，故意推搡，见死不救，还上门找茬，换我我也得发飙！”常伟趁辰楠分神，另一只手猛地挥来。辰楠早有防备，头一偏躲过这一击，同时一脚踹他屁股上，直接把常伟踢出屋外。这还不算，辰楠追出去，一把将常伟的手臂反扭到背后。“啊——！”常伟发出一声惨叫，整个人被迫弯腰，姿态狼狈。辰楠毫不留情，抬手又是两个响亮的耳光，打得常伟眼冒金星。接着一记膝撞顶在常伟腹部，常伟顿时弯成虾米状，干呕不止。辰楠暗自摇头，这常伟平日里在周边院里横着走，没想到这么不经打。“就这点本事？”辰楠冷笑，“也配来福缘胡同一号院嚣张？”常伟鼻涕眼泪一齐流下，哪还有先前的气势。他试图反击，但每次出手都被辰楠轻易化解，反而招来更狠的打击。不过几个照面，常伟已经鼻青脸肿，嘴角渗血。常伟想不明白这是怎么回事，以前他没少揍辰楠，可这次怎么反过来被揍了？不少人看得心惊肉跳，辰楠这孩子怕是真疯了，这要是把常伟打坏了，可怎么收场。不过话说回来，这常伟也是活该，平日里没少欺负人...“哎哟喂，这常伟家有点背景，辰楠这孩子怎么敢动手啊！完了完了，辰家这下可惹上大麻烦了！”“是常伟先动的手，辰楠只不过是自卫反击，我们可以作证！”“不动手就等着挨揍，是我我也会还手的！”“这辰楠什么时候变得这么厉害了？”“平时看他文文弱弱的，连桶水都提不利索，今儿个这是吃错药了？”邻居们议论纷纷，这一幕看着非常解气。“别打了！别打了！”常伟终于撑不住，连滚带爬地躲到柳如意身后，声音里带着哭腔，“这次是我不对，别打了！”辰楠这才停手，冷冷地看着躲在柳如意身后的常伟：“滚远点，别再让我看见你们来一号院闹事。否则...”他捏了捏拳头，骨节发出清脆的响声。常伟吓得一哆嗦，一旁的柳如意出神地看着辰楠。就在这时。一个苍老且严肃的声音传来。“吵吵闹闹的，这是怎么回事？”只见一个大爷拄着拐杖走来，人群纷纷让开道路。这是福缘胡同一号院最年长的赵大爷，也是院子管事的，今年都快七十岁了。“赵大爷，他们欺负人都欺负到我们院子来了，你可要给我做主啊！”辰楠快速把事情说了一遍，自然略去了黄金古董的秘密。只说昨天自已被常伟推了一把掉河里，二人见死不救，如今反来诬陷。他站在道德大义这边，常伟这顿打是白挨了，后期常伟想报复也找不到借口。而且他也不怕常伟报复他，否则就不会动手。赵大爷早就听说这事情，他冷哼一声，板着脸道：“常家小子，柳家闺女，你们这样做人可不厚道！”“推人下河，见死不救，还反咬一口，这是什么道理？”邻居们纷纷附和，指责之声不绝于耳。若非大家都是隔壁院子邻居，又实在是没证据，早就报公安来抓人了。常伟和柳如意百口莫辩，被管事大爷教训也不敢还嘴。也就这帮人没证据证明他推人下河，否则常伟相信这些人肯定送他去见公安。常伟连话都不敢回，拉着柳如意狼狈地往外走。院子里的人群自动分开一条道，各种目光投向二人——有鄙夷，有嘲讽，也有几分幸灾乐祸。“看什么看！”常伟恼羞成怒地吼了一句，却因为嘴角肿痛，声音变得含糊不清。柳如意低着头，脸涨得通红，恨不得找个地缝钻进去。她怎么也没想到，平日里对她唯命是从的辰楠，今天竟让她在这么多人面前丢尽了脸面。二人就在一号院众人的指指点点和窃窃私语中，灰溜溜地逃离了这个让他们颜面扫地的地方。走出院子时，常伟回过头恶狠狠地盯着辰楠。“你给我等着，我不会就这样算了的！”说完这狠话，头也不回地加快脚步走了。院子里倒是很热闹，并未听到常伟放的狠话，邻居们看着辰楠，眼神复杂。这个平日里温和有礼的年轻人，今天展现出的狠劲让所有人都大吃一惊。辰楠望着二人远去的背影，心中冷笑。这才只是开始，好戏还在后头。你们想要搞我，那我就先搞臭你们名声！这个年代的人都很注重名声，名声可是非常重要的。他拍了拍手上的灰，对众人点点头：“打扰大家了。”说完转身回屋，关上了房门。院里的邻居们面面相觑，半晌才有人低声开口。“看来老实人也不能随便欺负啊...”“可不是嘛，兔子急了还咬人呢！”“看来辰楠这是憋久了，老实人一发火，真是吓死人哟！”众人议论纷纷地散去，但每个人心里都明白。从今天起，福缘胡同一号院的辰楠，再也不是从前那个任人拿捏的软柿子。没想到平时文文弱弱的辰楠动起手来如此厉害。这还是他们以前认识的那个辰楠吗？看来被逼急了，再老实的人都会发癫。这不，辰楠刚才就在发癫。所以，没事别欺负老实人，老实人被逼急了一旦发癫，谁知道会做出什么事情来。屋里。辰楠转身回屋，看见父亲辰东南正望着他，眼中有着说不清道不明的复杂情绪。“爸，怎么了？”辰楠问。辰东南沉默片刻，才缓缓道：“小楠，你似乎...和以前不一样了。”辰楠心中一凛，面上却笑道：“人总是要长大的。”“差点被淹死，我想了许多，也懂了许多。”辰东南听了这话欣慰点头，儿子长大了啊。辰楠搀扶着父亲走向里屋，心中暗忖，空间里的灵泉溪水，是时候找个机会试试效果了。
content_en: "Chen Nan, how could you do this!" Liu Ruyi finally reacted and stepped forward to ask, "Let go of Chang Wei!" "Don't think that you are safe because you are a woman." Chen Nan turned to glance at her, his eyes as cold as knives, "If you say another word, I will beat you too." Liu Ruyi was frightened by that look and took half a step back, her lips trembling, but she no longer dared to say a word.She has never seen Chen Nan like this - Chen Nan used to be obedient to her and never said a harsh word, but now he seems to be a different person.The neighbors who were watching opened their eyes wide and exclaimed in surprise.The scene happening now is really strange.In their eyes, although Chen Nan is 1.8 meters tall, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, and handsome features (just like the readers here), Chen Nan is too weak, lacks nutrition, and looks stunted. He is a typical weak scholar and not much of a person to be honest.Chen Nan's changes today were beyond their imagination."Good guy, this Chen Nan is totally willing to give up! He used to be so nice to that girl, but now he dares to quarrel with her." "It seems that he was really pushed into a panic, but also, those two are so useless. They deliberately pushed and pushed, refused to save her, and even came to find trouble. If it were me, I would have gone crazy!" Chang Wei took advantage of Chen Nan's distraction and waved his other hand violently.Chen Nan was on guard and dodged the blow with a head tilt. At the same time, he kicked Chang Wei on the butt and kicked Chang Wei out of the house.Not to mention, Chen Nan chased after him and twisted Chang Wei's arm behind his back."Ah——!" Chang Wei let out a scream, his whole body was forced to bend down, and his posture was awkward.Chen Nan showed no mercy, raised his hand and slapped Chang Wei twice loudly, making stars appear in Chang Wei's eyes.Then a knee hit Chang Wei's abdomen. Chang Wei suddenly bent into a shrimp shape and retched.Chen Nan shook his head secretly. Chang Wei usually walked sideways in the surrounding courtyards, but he didn't expect to be beaten so easily."That's all you have?" Chen Nan sneered, "Does it deserve to be so arrogant in No. 1 Fuyuan Alley?" Chang Wei's nose and tears flowed down, but he still had the previous momentum.He tried to fight back, but every time he took action, Chen Nan easily defused it, and instead received more severe blows.After only a few interviews, Chang Wei's nose was bruised, his face was swollen, and blood was oozing from the corners of his mouth.Chang Wei couldn't figure out what was going on. He had beaten Chen Nan before, but why was he beaten this time?Many people were frightened when they saw it. Chen Nan was afraid that this kid was really crazy. What would happen if Chang Wei was broken by this?But having said that, Chang Wei deserves it. He usually bullies people... "Hey, Chang Wei's family has some background. How dare this kid Chen Nan do something! It's over, it's over, the Chen family is in big trouble now!" "Chang Wei was the first to attack, and Chen Nan was just fighting back in self-defense. WeI can testify!" "If you don't take action, I will fight back!" "When did Chen Nan become so powerful?" "I usually see him as weak and can't even carry a bucket of water.Did he take the wrong medicine today?" The neighbors were talking, and this scene looked very relieved."Stop fighting! Stop fighting!" Chang Wei finally couldn't hold on anymore and crawled to hide behind Liu Ruyi, with a cry in his voice, "It's my fault this time, don't fight!" Chen Nan stopped and looked coldly at Chang Wei who was hiding behind Liu Ruyi: "Get away, don't let me see you coming to No. 1 to cause trouble again. Otherwise..." He clenched his fists, and his joints made a crisp sound.Chang Wei trembled with fright, and Liu Ruyi on the side looked at Chen Nan in confusion.Just then.An old and serious voice came."It's noisy, what's going on?" I saw an old man walking on crutches, and the crowd moved out of the way.This is Uncle Zhao, the eldest man in No. 1 Courtyard in Fuyuan Alley and the manager of the courtyard. He is almost 70 years old this year."Uncle Zhao, their bullies have come to our yard, you have to make the decision for me!" Chen Nan quickly explained the matter, naturally omitting the secret of the golden antique.He only said that yesterday he was pushed by Chang Wei and fell into the river. The two of them refused to save him, and now they are framed.He stood on the side of morality and justice. Chang Wei's beating was in vain. Chang Wei couldn't find an excuse for revenge later.And he wasn't afraid of Chang Wei retaliating against him, otherwise he wouldn't take action.Uncle Zhao had heard about this a long time ago. He snorted coldly and said with a straight face: "Young man from the Chang family, daughter from the Liu family, you are not very kind to do this!" "Pushing someone into the river, refusing to save him until he died, and then biting him back. What's the point?" Neighbors agreed one after another, and the voices of accusation were endless.If everyone hadn't been neighbors in the next yard, and there was really no evidence, the police would have been called to arrest him.Chang Wei and Liu Ruyi couldn't argue, and they didn't dare to talk back even after being lectured by the steward.This group of people had no evidence to prove that he pushed people into the river, otherwise Chang Wei believed that these people would definitely send him to see the police.Chang Wei didn't even dare to reply, and pulled Liu Ruyi out in embarrassment.The crowd in the courtyard automatically separated into a lane, and all kinds of eyes were cast on the two of them - some with contempt, some with ridicule, and some with schadenfreude."What are you looking at!" Chang Wei yelled angrily, but his voice became muffled because of the swelling and pain at the corners of his mouth.Liu Ruyi lowered her head, her face turned red, and she wanted to find a crack in the ground to crawl in.She never expected that Chen Nan, who usually obeyed her orders, would actually make her lose face in front of so many people today.Amid the pointing and whispering of everyone in No. 1 Courtyard, the two of them fled in despair from this place that disgraced them.When walking out of the yard, Chang Wei turned around and stared at Chen Nan fiercely."Just wait for me, I won't let it go like this!" After saying these cruel words, he quickened his pace and walked away without looking back.The yard was very lively, and Chang Weifang's harsh words were not heard. The neighbors looked at Chen Nan with complicated expressions.This normally gentle and polite young man surprised everyone with his fierceness today.Chen Nan looked at the two people's retreating figures and sneered in his heart.This is just the beginning, the fun is yet to come.If you want to mess with me, then I will ruin your reputation first!People in this era attach great importance to reputation, and reputation is very important.He patted the dust on his hands and nodded to everyone: "Sorry to bother everyone." After saying that, he turned back to the house and closed the door.The neighbors in the courtyard looked at each other, and after a long while someone spoke in a low voice."It seems that honest people can't be bullied casually..." "That's right, the rabbit bites people when it's angry!" "It seems that Chen Nan has been holding it in for a long time. When an honest person gets angry, it's really scary!" Everyone dispersed with discussion, but everyone understood in their hearts.From today on, Chen Nan, who lives in Courtyard No. 1, Fuyuan Alley, is no longer the soft persimmon that others can manipulate.I didn't expect that Chen Nan, who was usually weak and gentle, could act so powerfully.Is this still the Chen Nan they knew before?It seems that when pressed, no matter how honest a person is, he will go crazy.No, Chen Nan was going crazy just now.So, don’t bully honest people if you have nothing to do. Who knows what an honest person will do if he gets mad and goes crazy.inside the house.Chen Nan turned around and went back to the house, and saw his father Chen Nannan looking at him, with indescribable complex emotions in his eyes."Dad, what's wrong?" Chen Nan asked.Chen Nannan was silent for a moment, and then slowly said: "Xiao Nan, you seem to be... different from before." Chen Nan's heart froze, but he smiled on his face: "People always have to grow up." "I almost drowned. I thought a lot and understood a lot." Chen Nannan nodded happily after hearing this. His son has grown up.Chen Nan helped her father towards the back room, thinking to herself that it was time to find a chance to test the effect of the spiritual spring water in the space.
